title: Generalizable field of view extension for diffusion MRI via conditional flow matching
abstract: arXiv:2610.17401v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Incomplete field-of-view (FOV) diffusion MRI (dMRI) acquisitions compromise whole-brain white matter analysis by excluding brain regions from tractography and connectivity studies. While deep generative models for dMRI FOV extension have been proposed, their generalizability remains limited by the acquisition-dependent nature of dMRI, where signal intensity varies with b-value, gradient direction, and scanner protocol, and the inherent 4D complexity of the data, making it difficult to train models that transfer across sites or acquisition schemes without retraining. We propose a flow-matching generative model that extends the dMRI FOV in both the superior and inferior directions by predicting apparent diffusion coefficients (ADC) in six directions, conditioned on the two nearest acquired slices and the full-FOV T1w image to enforce both local diffusion continuity and anatomical consistency. translated_abstract: 不完整的视野（FOV）扩散磁共振成像（dMRI）采集会将部分脑区排除在纤维追踪和连接性研究之外，从而损害全脑白质分析。尽管已有针对dMRI视野扩展的深度生成模型被提出，但其泛化能力仍然受限，原因在于dMRI的采集依赖性——信号强度随b值、梯度方向和扫描仪协议而变化——以及数据固有的四维复杂性，这使得很难训练出无需重新训练就能跨站点或跨采集方案迁移的模型。我们提出了一种流匹配生成模型，通过在六个方向上预测表观扩散系数（ADC），在上方和下方两个方向扩展dMRI视野。该模型以最近的两个已采集切片和全视野T1加权图像为条件，从而同时保证局部扩散连续性和解剖学一致性。ADC表示使模型与（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 提出一种基于条件流匹配的生成模型，通过在六个方向预测ADC并以邻近已采集切片和全视野T1加权图像为条件，实现了可跨扫描站点和采集方案泛化的扩散磁共振视野扩展。
en_tdlr: A conditional flow-matching generative model predicts ADC in six directions, conditioned on the nearest acquired slices and full-FOV T1w images, enabling generalizable field-of-view extension for diffusion MRI across sites and acquisition schemes without retraining.
